name: What is the process for a shower or tub upgrade with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a shower or tub upgrade with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Following this, we conduct an on-site visit to assess the existing space and take measurements. We then provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, and timeline. Once approved, we handle permit applications if needed, schedule the work, and manage the project through to completion. Communication is maintained throughout to ensure your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our upgrade process involves consultation, on-site assessment, detailed proposal, permit handling, scheduling, and project management with continuous communication.
